title: Sidang Deuek .
intro: Saboh masyarakat, nyang meuheut keu pimpinan keu geubela peukara awaknyan, geulakèe mangat sidroe panglima geutunyok ateuh awaknyan. Watee permintaan awaknyan geujaweub, ureueng nyang geupiléh nyan geusambot deungon skeptisisme, sabab ureueng nyoe hana status donya nyang awaknyan harapkan. Sigohlom konfrontasi njang akhé, peumimpin barô njoë akan geu-uji disiplin teuntra deungon uji peutheun njang sederhana, tapi meudalam.
clues: Ulôn geuangkèë seubagoë panglima lheuëh bansa ulôn tuntut sidroë peumimpin untôk meuprang dalam djalan Allah.
Le that ureuëng ulôn keudroë njang awai djipeu-ingat keu peulantikan ulôn, deungon alasan ulôn kureuëng hareuta dan keuturunan mulia.
Lon geupiléh sabab Allah ka geubri ilme nyang le dan badan fisik nyang meukuasa.
Tanda nyang jeulaih nibak peulantikan ilahi ulôn na kheueh keulai Peuto Peujanjian, nyang jiba lé malaikat, nyang jiba damé ubak até ureuëng-ureuëng meuiman.
Bak watée ulôn jak ngon tantra-tantra ulôn, ulôn peugah bahwa kamoe teuma teu-ujoe lé saboh krueng.
Lon peurintah bak pasukan lon bahwa soe mantong nyang jieb ie lam krueng nyan kon lam pasukan lon, seudangkan nyang mantong jicok saboh sendok lam jaroe jih akan teutap.

trial.label: Peue Cobaan Utama Lon?
options: Meubangun saboh peunghalang keu jilawan Gog ngon Magog .
Meu-uji keutaatan teuntra bak saboh kruëng
trial.answer: Meu-uji keutaatan teuntra bak saboh kruëng

location.label: Peue Tanda Utama Keu Otoritas Lon?
options: Saboh tungkat nyang meuubah jeuet keu uleue .
Saboh unta nyang jiteubiet nibak batée .
Saboh mantel nyang jipeugot nibak beusoe nyang ka leumoh .

outcome.label: Peue Hase Kampanye Lon?
options: Meupisah La'ôt Mirah keu peuleupah droe nibak sidroe tiran .
Meudong saboh dinasti nyang treb ateuh nan lon .

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
